introduction.title: Tien Dai Phat Investment Joint Stock Company
introduction.content1: Tien Dai Phat Investment Joint Stock Company is proud to be one of the pioneers in Vietnam in the field of medical equipment manufacturing and trading. With a vision and mission to deliver high-quality Made in Vietnam products, we continuously research, innovate, and improve our production technology to meet the ever-increasing demands of the market.
introduction.content2: In addition to manufacturing medical equipment, the Company is also actively involved in other sectors such as waterway dredging, mineral exploitation, production investment, and business - trade cooperation.
introduction.detailAdd: No. 11/18/199 Ho Tung Mau Street, Cau Dien Ward, Nam Tu Liem District, Hanoi City, Vietnam

history.title: Development History
history.content1: The predecessor of Tien Dai Phat Investment Joint Stock Company specialized in trading mechanical equipment, vocational training equipment, and medical devices to serve domestic clients. Recognizing the trend of market transformation, the company underwent a restructuring process, focusing on the production of medical equipment and expanding into other business sectors.
history.content2: This transformation reflects a strategic vision aligned with future trends, laying the foundation for sustainable and comprehensive development, while affirming the company's position as a market leader.
history.content3: ISO 9001:2000 Certification (achieved in 2006): Marked a significant milestone in the company’s development and demonstrated its commitment to quality and credibility.

visionMission.title: Vision and Mission
visionMission.content: The world is constantly changing, leading to diversification and multilateralization in global supply chains. Seizing this opportunity, we continuously learn and innovate to become a pioneering force, staying ahead of trends, leading the market, and capturing new opportunities.

investmentProduction.contentIntroduction: Recognizing the immense potential and growth space of the domestic market, Tien Dai Phat Investment Joint Stock Company has boldly invested, explored, and learned to develop core technology, aiming to become a part of the high-value supply chain of both the country and the world.

investmentProduction.statisticsMinistryFinance: According to statistics from the Ministry of Finance
investmentProduction.content1: Foreign investment projects in Vietnam in several technology-related sectors valid until January 2025 (Cumulative)
investmentProduction.content2: Implemented capital and new projects by foreign investors in Vietnam (2024–2025)
investmentProduction.mainSubContent2: 149 countries and territories have invested in Vietnam with 42,272 projects and a total registered capital of USD 505.4 billion. South Korea ranks first, followed by Singapore, Japan, and Taiwan.
investmentProduction.contentTop: Over the past two decades, Vietnam has emerged as one of the fastest-growing economies in the region, with an average GDP growth of 6–7% per year. What makes Vietnam stand out is not only economic growth but also a strong shift toward high-tech, manufacturing, digital transformation, and green transition.
investmentProduction.contentBottom: Vietnam is currently a crucial part of the global supply chain, with participation from many leading technology corporations such as Samsung, Intel, Foxconn, and LG. Vietnam is also rapidly expanding its semiconductor ecosystem, with the presence of numerous chip manufacturing plants and R&D centers.

dredgingLandfill.contentIntroduction: Tien Dai Phat is proud to be the domestic company that owns the largest dredging vessel in Vietnam and is currently the only unit with a full capability profile to carry out major, complex, and key offshore projects.

medicalEquipment.contentIntro1: Tien Dai Phat started with importing and supplying medical equipment to both public and private hospitals nationwide, from central to local levels.
medicalEquipment.contentIntro2: With a vision of self-reliance and independence in technology and production, Tien Dai Phat has invested in research and development to proactively supply various types of medical equipment in Vietnam.
medicalEquipment.contentIntro3: Our first milestone was the development and production of highly sensitive medical equipment in the field of Hemodialysis. Tien Dai Phat confidently positions itself as a pioneer in the Made in Vietnam market.
medicalEquipment.nameProduct1: Artificial Kidney Filter / PES Membrane / Low-flux
medicalEquipment.info1Product1: Low membrane permeability: Smaller membrane pores.
medicalEquipment.info2Product1: Primarily removes small molecules like urea through diffusion.
medicalEquipment.info3Product1: Typically suitable for patients with milder kidney failure.
medicalEquipment.nameProduct2: Artificial Kidney Filter / PES Membrane / High-flux
medicalEquipment.info1Product2: High membrane permeability: Larger membrane pores.
medicalEquipment.info2Product2: Removes small, medium, and large molecules through diffusion and convection.
medicalEquipment.info3Product3: Suitable for patients with more severe kidney failure, offering more effective toxin removal.
